prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting failed electrical appliance safety checks

1. Start with the test records.
2.
completion:
Check the T base you will be using e.g. New 17th edition test record TM1.
3. Check all basic visual check have been carried out.
4. Enter the date of the test.
5. Enter the identification number of the appliance – it is mandatory to attach the in-date label to the appliance, this must have an identification number to identify the item and the date of the test mark, replacing this if appropriate.
6. Enter the serial numbers e.g. serial plate if they are present.
7. Carry out basic visual checks, 1.1, 1.2.1, 1.2.2, 1.2.3, 1.3, 1.4, 1.5, 1.6, 1.6.1, 1.6.2.
8. Make a note of any of the above defects.
